assets.title: Week 7 opener materials bridge board
assets.description: A compact opener board with garments and swatches that clearly suggest different materials so students can bridge from visual description to fabric description.
assets.notes: Use as a fast review-preview board. Include visually clear denim, a soft light fabric, a shiny fabric, and a lace-like fabric. Keep the scene uncluttered so students can answer quick recognition questions.

assets.title: Common fabric and material swatch board
assets.description: One combined board showing common fabric and material examples with visible keys for the main Week 7 materials-matching task.
assets.notes: Required visible-key strategy: A cotton, B denim, C linen, D silk, E wool, F polyester, G knit fabric, H woven fabric, I lace, J leather. The image, activity answers, and prompt notes must all use the same A-J labels.

assets.title: Texture and material qualities board
assets.description: A combined board showing clear keyed examples of fabric texture, surface, weight, movement, and visibility.
assets.notes: Required visible-key strategy: A soft, B rough, C smooth, D shiny, E matte, F lightweight, G heavy, H stretchy, I stiff, J flowy, K structured, L transparent, M opaque. The image, activity answers, and prompt notes must all use the same A-M labels.

assets.title: Three-swatch reading gallery
assets.description: A reading gallery with three clearly separated swatches for matching short fabric descriptions to image A, image B, and image C.
assets.notes: Required image-key strategy: image A is a white cotton swatch, image B is a blue denim swatch, and image C is a black lace swatch. The reading texts, activity answers, and prompt notes must all use the same A-C mapping.

assets.title: Reusable four-swatch fabric gallery
assets.description: A reusable gallery with four clearly separated fabric swatches for listening, writing, and speaking.
assets.notes: Required image-key strategy: image A is white cotton, image B is blue denim, image C is smooth shiny silk, and image D is black lace. The listening script, writing-card options, speaking prompts, and prompt notes must all use the same A-D mapping.

assets.title: Which fabric is it listening audio
assets.description: A short Week 7 listening clip describing four fabrics by color, feel, look, weight, and garment use.
assets.notes: Transcript remains inside audio_prompts.json only. Do not create a separate transcript asset in the current phase.
